title: Official Gold BIS Hallmark Stamp Card
title_te: అధికారిక బంగారు బీఐఎస్ హాల్‌మార్క్ ముద్ర కార్డ్
problem: When Amma pledged her small gold earrings during an emergency, the pawn broker offered very little cash, claiming the gold was low quality.
idea: A pocket card that explains the BIS hallmark, plus a calculator that shows how much pure gold is in jewellery, so families know its real value.

widgets.heading: 🔎 The 3 Marks of a Real Hallmark

items.title: BIS logo
items.text: A triangle-shaped BIS mark of the Bureau of Indian Standards.

items.title: 6-digit HUID code
items.text: A unique 6-character code (letters + numbers) for each piece.
items.te: ప్రతి నగకు ప్రత్యేకమైన 6 అక్షరాల హెచ్‌యూఐడీ కోడ్.

items.title: Verify in BIS CARE app
items.text: Type the HUID in the free BIS CARE app to check it.
items.te: బీఐఎస్ కేర్ యాప్‌లో హెచ్‌యూఐడీ టైప్ చేసి తనిఖీ చేయండి.

widgets.heading: 🧮 Try it: How much pure gold is in my jewellery?
widgets.intro: Type the weight from the jewellery bill and today's 24K gold rate from a trusted source. This shows the gold value only – shops and lenders may cut charges.
widgets.formula: if (grams <= 0 || rate24 <= 0) return null; var p = Number(purity) / 1000; var pure = grams * p; return {pure: pure, value: Math.round(pure * rate24), pct: Number(purity) / 10, level: 'good'};
widgets.result:
Purity: {pct}% gold
Pure gold inside: {pure} grams
Value of pure gold ≈ ₹{value}
Compare offers from 2-3 places (banks also give gold loans).

questions.q: How many characters is the HUID code?
A broker says your hallmarked gold is 'low quality'. What can you do?
options: Check the HUID in the BIS CARE app and ask another bank/shop
questions.why: The hallmark is official proof of purity.

how: Ask Gemini to explain the BIS hallmark: logo, purity grade and HUID.
Look at a family jewellery bill and the stamp with a magnifying glass (with Amma's permission).
Install the free BIS CARE app with a parent and try 'Verify HUID'.
Ask Gemini to make a short table of purity grades (22K916, 18K750, 14K585).
Design a pocket-size card in Canva with pictures of the 3 marks and Telugu text.
Print cards for mothers in the self-help group.
prompt: I am a Class 8 student. Explain the official BIS gold hallmark in simple English and Telugu: the BIS logo, purity grade (like 22K916) and the 6-digit HUID code, and how to verify the HUID in the BIS CARE app. Also show how to calculate pure gold weight from purity (e.g., 4 grams of 22K916).
